causal_timing_concerns: The base next-bar rule is causal, but availability-timestamp construction and equal-timestamp tie handling are not fully specified.
The five-interval holding rule is ambiguous about counting the entry-to-next-rebalance interval and the exact session generating the time exit.
The additional-delay stress does not specify whether the original order is queued unchanged, superseded by later signals, or evaluated through a separate delayed state machine.
Fold interval inclusion specifies only an endpoint condition; the start-boundary rule and terminal-fill treatment are incomplete.
Quarantine currently combines no fill, absent returns, and state reset, which can erase live economic exposure and break causal self-financing accounting.
rationale: The signal direction and state logic are substantively mean-reverting rather than a retuned version of the rejected trend family.
Revision is required because holding-clock, quarantine, fold, variant, and statistical definitions currently allow materially different implementations before freeze.
No holdout access, return calculation, performance inference, capital authorization, or change to the frozen trend rejection is justified.
required_revisions: State an ex-ante economic mechanism for reversal and explain why its expected decay aligns with the three-session shock and five-interval maximum hold.
Define independent per-asset state machines, simultaneous-order priority, the exact holding-clock origin, whether the entry interval counts, and the precise forced-exit execution session.

Make missing-data behavior self-financing: an existing long position cannot disappear when state resets or affected returns are omitted; specify exposure, marking, delayed liquidation, costs, and PnL across quarantine.
Freeze exact accounting equations for drifted pre-trade weights, trade notionals, cash-funded costs, insufficient cash, simultaneous BTC/ETH trades, benchmark turnover, and terminal liquidation.
Specify fold-start eligibility, permitted warmup observations, first tradable signal, holding-clock reset, interval assignment, and the final liquidation required before each half-open fold ends.
Fully define the slower-volatility-estimator variant and freeze the exact seven-trial mapping used by DSR and PBO.
Strengthen or justify sparse-trade gates; eight total entries and two per asset do not establish adequate independent evidence for the proposed statistical tests.
Require raw-drawdown-baseline superiority on both Sharpe and maximum drawdown, or preregister a defensible asymmetric comparison rationale.

Freeze self-contained DSR, PBO, bootstrap, regime, concentration, holdout, and prospective-decision algorithms, including edge cases, rather than relying only on prose references to the rejected trend experiment.

Make holdout evaluation explicitly one-shot and terminal on failure, map every development gate unambiguously to the two holdout folds, and define prospective independent asset decisions and immutable post-freeze accounting.
statistical_concerns: Trade minima are too sparse relative to DSR, 8-block CSCV/PBO, bootstrap, fold, asset, and regime inference.
The slower-volatility trial is unnamed parametrically, leaving multiplicity and PBO inputs unreproducible.
The bootstrap lacks the exact 95% lower-bound construction, daily-series assembly, zero-return treatment, and degenerate-sample handling.
DSR and PBO lack complete formulas, scoring conventions, tie rules, zero-variance handling, and failure behavior in this draft.
Regime eligibility counts intervals rather than active or independent decisions, so mostly-cash regimes may satisfy sample-size thresholds without meaningful exposure.
Exceptional-day limits do not define scope or denominator edge cases and do not directly constrain asset-level PnL concentration.
strengths: The primary is genuinely distinct: contrarian standardized drawdown entry, recovery/time exit, long-or-cash exposure, and no trend signal or volatility targeting.
Signals use completed sessions, base fills are explicitly next-valid-bar, and cost, doubled-cost, delay, initial/terminal-cost, leverage, and capital constraints are preregistered.
The primary cannot be replaced by a variant; walk-forward folds, asset gates, regime gates, concentration limits, DSR, PBO, bootstrap, and raw-drawdown comparison are contemplated.
Holdout opening requires all development gates plus independent Sol/xhigh approval, and prospective evaluation remains zero-capital.
